name: connect-palette-subcommands
description: Typing /conn in the command menu lists /connect subcommands, and extending it to '/connect an' filters to 'answer' (issue #100). The hub stays enabled because it registers /connect; HOME is a temp dir, so the instance never joins the developer's mesh or relay.

config.command: bash -lc 'R=$(pwd); H=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$H/.kollab"; printf "%s" "{\"kollabor\":{\"llm\":{\"active_profile\":\"openai-test\",\"profiles\":{\"openai-test\":{\"provider\":\"openai\",\"model\":\"gpt-5.5\",\"base_url\":\"https://api.openai.com/v1\",\"api_key\":\"sk-test-dummy\",\"supports_tools\":true}}}},\"plugins\":{\"hub\":{\"enabled\":true}}}" > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; ln -s "$R/plugins" "$H/plugins"; cd "$H"; HOME="$H" PYTHONPATH="$R" "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --no-daemon'

steps.pattern: Create a one-device, five-minute enrollment code
steps.description: offer is listed with its description
